source_review: Berkeley Meeting 12: hybrid agent boundaries and uses of model output. Kept the separation between a model's proposal, the application's decision and an observed effect.

SQLite binding and transactions; RFC 9110 §13.1.1; Microsoft Transactional Outbox. Replaced the SQL example with exact title lookup and owner filtering; retained approved snapshots, revocation, rollback, lost acknowledgment and idempotent enqueue.

Progent v1 and v3: deny rules, no implicit permissions, fail-closed comparison and generic-first evaluation per Algorithm 4. Kept the distinction between a configurable policy approver and explicit user approval.

Reviewed Privtrans, complete mediation and least privilege, separation of provenance and authorization, and false positives/false negatives for a document detector. Research context stays at the level of measured outcomes and defensive controls.
provenance: Eight earlier originals retained without modifying their binary data or rights. Added descriptive alt text. Kept the Microsoft outbox source and references to prior research; did not add a duplicate of removed material.

verification.code: Ran four chapter-authored Python examples in isolation. Bound SQL owner/title lookup handles an apostrophe as data; wrong actor, changed draft, modified payload, revoked grant and rollback do not create new outbox rows. A lost response after commit and retry resolve to one queued row. The working examples do not call a mail API or run a detector.
verification.contention: Two connections to an isolated temporary SQLite file: a second writer returned SQLITE_BUSY after BEGIN IMMEDIATE and succeeded after the first transaction committed. Distinguish this local atomicity from remote exactly-once delivery.
verification.grounding: Checked policy ordering against Progent v3 Algorithm 4 and the original v1 diagram, conditional writes against RFC 9110 §13.1.1 and SQLite, published outcome metrics against the AgentPoison evaluation definitions, and the source quotation from Saltzer and Schroeder.
verification.parity: Eight original figures byte-match the prior Bookvar dev snapshot. Three defensive examples, two displayed formulas and 15 source unit IDs preserved. Old heading fragments remain available; no reverse patch republishes removed material.
verification.reader: Built 2099 pages. Chromium at 390 and 1440 CSS px: 8 images, both formulas, old IDs, previous chapter, and return to textbook contents; no viewport overflow or math errors. Inspected the boundary slide, Progent drawing and outbox; verified source link, 2×, fit and both edges.
